question: 查询 FoodServiceImpl.getAllFood 的完整上游调用链，包括入口 API 和有序方法路径。
cypher:
MATCH (entryMethod:方法)-[:服务于]->(entryApi:上游API)
MATCH (entryMethod)-[:接口调用]->(anchorMethod:方法)
WHERE anchorMethod.方法名 = 'getAllFood'
RETURN DISTINCT
  anchorMethod.全限定名 AS 目标方法,
  entryApi.API路径 AS 入口API,
  [entryMethod.全限定名, anchorMethod.全限定名] AS 方法路径

UNION

MATCH (entryMethod:方法)-[:服务于]->(entryApi:上游API)
MATCH path = (entryMethod)-[:链中下一节点*1..5]->(anchorMethod:方法)
WHERE
  anchorMethod.方法名 = 'getAllFood' AND
  ALL(
    pathRelationship IN relationships(path)
    WHERE pathRelationship.路径签名 = relationships(path)[0].路径签名
  ) AND
  (
    size(relationships(path)) = 1 OR
    ALL(
      index IN range(1, size(relationships(path)) - 1)
      WHERE
        relationships(path)[index].位置索引 =
        relationships(path)[index - 1].位置索引 + 1
    )
  )
RETURN DISTINCT
  anchorMethod.全限定名 AS 目标方法,
  entryApi.API路径 AS 入口API,
  [method IN nodes(path) | method.全限定名] AS 方法路径

UNION

MATCH (entryMethod:方法)-[:服务于]->(entryApi:上游API)
MATCH (entryMethod)-[:接口调用]->(firstMethod:方法)
MATCH path = (firstMethod)-[:链中下一节点*1..4]->(anchorMethod:方法)
WHERE
  anchorMethod.方法名 = 'getAllFood' AND
  ALL(
    pathRelationship IN relationships(path)
    WHERE pathRelationship.路径签名 = relationships(path)[0].路径签名
  ) AND
  (
    size(relationships(path)) = 1 OR
    ALL(
      index IN range(1, size(relationships(path)) - 1)
      WHERE
        relationships(path)[index].位置索引 =
        relationships(path)[index - 1].位置索引 + 1
    )
  )
RETURN DISTINCT
  anchorMethod.全限定名 AS 目标方法,
  entryApi.API路径 AS 入口API,
  [entryMethod.全限定名] + [method IN nodes(path) | method.全限定名]
    AS 方法路径

UNION

MATCH (anchorMethod:方法)-[:服务于]->(entryApi:上游API)
WHERE anchorMethod.方法名 = 'getAllFood'
RETURN DISTINCT
  anchorMethod.全限定名 AS 目标方法,
  entryApi.API路径 AS 入口API,
  [anchorMethod.全限定名] AS 方法路径
aliases: 追踪方法的入口 API 与完整上游方法路径
查询到达目标方法的有序上游链

question: 查询 InsidePaymentServiceImpl.pay 的完整下游调用链，包括方法路径、下游 API、目标服务和目标入口 API。

MATCH (anchorMethod:方法)-[:下游调用]->(downstreamApi:下游API)
WHERE
  anchorMethod.所属类名 ENDS WITH '.InsidePaymentServiceImpl' AND
  anchorMethod.方法名 = 'pay'
OPTIONAL MATCH (downstreamApi)-[:目标服务]->(targetService:微服务)
OPTIONAL MATCH (downstreamApi)-[:外部调用]->(targetApi:上游API)

  targetApi.API路径 AS 目标上游API,
  targetEntryMethod.全限定名 AS 目标入口方法

MATCH path = (anchorMethod:方法)-[:链中下一节点*1..5]->(outboundMethod:方法)
  -[:下游调用]->(downstreamApi:下游API)
WHERE
  anchorMethod.所属类名 ENDS WITH '.InsidePaymentServiceImpl' AND
  anchorMethod.方法名 = 'pay' AND
  ALL(
    pathRelationship IN relationships(path)
    WHERE pathRelationship.路径签名 = relationships(path)[0].路径签名

  (
    size(relationships(path)) = 1 OR
    ALL(
      index IN range(1, size(relationships(path)) - 1)
      WHERE
        relationships(path)[index].位置索引 =
        relationships(path)[index - 1].位置索引 + 1
    )
  )
OPTIONAL MATCH (downstreamApi)-[:目标服务]->(targetService:微服务)
OPTIONAL MATCH (downstreamApi)-[:外部调用]->(targetApi:上游API)
OPTIONAL MATCH (targetEntryMethod:方法)-[:服务于]->(targetApi)
RETURN DISTINCT
  anchorMethod.全限定名 AS 目标方法,
  [method IN nodes(path) | method.全限定名] AS 方法路径,
  downstreamApi.API路径 AS 下游API,
  targetService.服务名称 AS 下游服务,
  targetApi.API路径 AS 目标上游API,
  targetEntryMethod.全限定名 AS 目标入口方法
